name: cosmic-button
title: Cosmic Button
description: A dark rounded button wrapped in a thick lime-green border whose gradient slowly rotates. It grows slightly on hover, takes a green focus ring and keeps a plain white label.
use: One primary action needs a distinctive glowing frame that still reads on dark pages.
avoid: The lime palette is hardcoded in its classes, so it fights a brand that uses other colours.
a11y: Focus works and shows a ring, but the lime ring sits on a lime border and reduced motion is not honoured. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle with a dark grey face and a thick lime-green rim, holding a line of white text. The rim shifts between pale yellow-green and deep olive as the gradient turns.
behaves: The green rim is a rotating gradient, so the colour slides around the edge without pause. On hover the whole button grows a little and the glow around the rim thickens.
customise: The label comes in as children; element type, class names, link target and rel are props. The lime gradient colours are hardcoded in the classes.
weight: light: Two CSS keyframe animations on gradient spans, with no script loop.
